name: model-comparison-v1
motivation: In the prompt-v2 development run, 26% of provider attempts on nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free failed on the provider side (overload, timeouts), leaving 11 of 50 questions unanswered for provider reasons alone.

fixed.budgets: 3 attempts, 1 retry, 45s per request, 90s per question

excluded.liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free: 2.6B parameters; too small for the task
excluded.nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini:free: smaller sibling of a listed candidate
excluded.openrouter/free: random router; forbidden for controlled runs (technical PRD 6.2)
excluded.models without response_format: strict JSON schema output is required

procedure: Gate 1: one structured-output probe request (check_openrouter.py --generate). Fail -> excluded.

Gate 2: the 11 controlled fixtures. Any failure on no-evidence, wrong-evidence-memory-temptation, instruction-in-source, or personal-advice -> excluded, whatever its accuracy. Other fixture failures are reported.
Then the full 50-question development run, each model its own separately identified run.

decision_rule.score: mean of fact strict accuracy and list F1, both over all 50 attempted questions (non-answers score zero)
decision_rule.choose: the highest score among models passing both gates
decision_rule.near_tie: within 0.05 of the best: prefer the higher answered rate, then the lower p50 latency
decision_rule.incumbent_kept_unless: a candidate's score exceeds it; the paired bootstrap interval is reported either way
decision_rule.uncertainty: 50 questions cannot separate small differences; the report states intervals and does not claim a winner from noise
